title: ReturnEnvelope
description: Schema evolution: every file carries schema_version, starting at 1. A reader that encounters a schema_version higher than the one it knows REFUSES the document — it never best-efforts; the validator reports this as a distinctly named schema_version_too_new violation. Adding a value to an enum bumps schema_version if and only if some consumer branches on that enum with a documented default or else path. No bump: tools, profile.allow grants, permission_mode, isolation, agent, return.kind. Bump: outcome, level, escalate_to, postcondition. When in doubt, bump. Validation is TWO-STEP in code: the envelope first, then `body` against the dispatch record's `return`. kind markdown means body is a string and every required_sections entry must appear as a markdown heading line. kind json means body is an object validated against the record's return.schema_path. The PARENT, not the worker, writes returns/<stem>.md for doc-tab display after validation — no grant covers that file. No $ref is needed anywhere because the two steps are separate calls.

body.description: No further keywords; validated in a second step.
